name: pi-desktop-antigravity-plugin
description: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist as a native PI-Desktop provider: chat, in-chat image generation, grounded web search, quota monitoring.
author: yunzinan
comment:undici: Vendored under node_modules/ on purpose: the plugin is installed as a package, not through npm install, and the app's Node process needs a ProxyAgent to reach Google behind a system proxy. See README.
